sentences.en: Well, I've been talking to managers in a number of businesses, and reading surveys about the future of management.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我一直在与多家企业的管理者交谈，并阅读有关管理未来发展的调查报告。

sentences.en: And what I'm going to present in this seminar is a few ideas about how the activity is likely to change in the next ten years.
sentences.zh: 在本次研讨会上，我将介绍一些关于未来十年管理活动可能如何变化的想法。

sentences.en: It isn't a scientific, statistical analysis - just some ideas for us to discuss.
sentences.zh: 这并非一项科学的统计分析——仅是一些供我们讨论的想法。

sentences.en: One area I want to mention is business markets, and I'm sure a really significant development will be a major increase in competition, with companies from all round the world trying to sell similar products.
sentences.zh: 我想提及的一个领域是商业市场，我确信一个真正重要的发展趋势将是竞争大幅加剧，来自世界各地的公司都在试图销售类似的产品。

sentences.en: Consumers will have much more choice - for instance, food products sold in Australia might be manufactured in the USA, China, Finland and dozens of other countries.
sentences.zh: 消费者将拥有远为丰富的选择——例如，在澳大利亚销售的食品可能产自美国、中国、芬兰以及数十个其他国家。

sentences.en: At the same time, mergers and takeovers mean that governments are actually losing power to major global corporations.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，并购意味着各国政府实际上正将权力让渡给大型全球性企业。

sentences.en: We can probably all think of companies that exert great deal of influence, which may be good for consumers.
sentences.zh: 我们大概都能想到一些具有巨大影响力的企业，这种影响力对消费者而言或许是有益的。

sentences.en: A third point I want to make about markets iS that in the rapidly expanding economies, such as India, China, Brazil and Russia, demand is growing very fast.
sentences.zh: 关于市场的第三点是，在印度、中国、巴西和俄罗斯等快速扩张的经济体中，需求正以极快的速度增长。

sentences.en: This is putting pressure on resources all over the world.
sentences.zh: 这给全球各地的资源带来了压力。

sentences.en: think businesses are becoming more open to external influences.
sentences.zh: 我认为企业正变得越来越开放，更易受到外部影响。

sentences.en: In particular, companies are consulting customers more and more before making their business decisions.
sentences.zh: 尤其是，企业在做出商业决策前，正越来越多地征询客户意见。

sentences.en: Companies are finding out what they want and providing it, instead of making products and then trying to sell them, which is the model of years ago.
sentences.zh: 企业正在了解客户所需并据此提供产品，而非沿袭过去那种先生产再设法推销的模式。

sentences.en: Another influence is that concerns about the environment will force manufacturers to extend product lifecycles, to reduce the amount of pollution and waste.
sentences.zh: 另一项影响在于，环保关切将迫使制造商延长产品生命周期，以减少污染和浪费。

sentences.en: And in some cases.
sentences.zh: 在某些情况下，

sentences.en: regulation will need to be strengthened.
sentences.zh: 监管力度需要加强。

sentences.en: Many societies are much more fluid and democratic, and the structure of companies is changing to reflect that.
sentences.zh: 许多社会变得更加流动化和民主化，而企业结构也正随之改变以反映这一趋势。

sentences.en: I think we're going to see a greater emphasis within companies on teams created with a specific project in mind.
sentences.zh: 我认为，企业内部将更加重视围绕特定项目组建的团队。

sentences.en: And when they're completed, the teams will be disbanded and new ones formed.
sentences.zh: 当项目完成后，这些团队将解散，并组建新的团队。

sentences.en: More and more people see work as simply one part of their lifestyle, and not the most important one, and as the workforce is shrinking in some countries, businesses are having to compete for staff instead of being able to choose among a lot of applicants.
sentences.zh: 越来越多的人将工作仅仅视为其生活方式的一部分，而非最重要的一部分；同时，由于某些国家劳动力人口正在缩减，企业不得不竞相争夺员工，而无法再从大量应聘者中随意挑选。

sentences.en: Typical examples that will attract and retain staff are traditional ones like flexible hours and something that has been made possible by advances in technology - - remote working, with people based at their home, abroad, or almost anywhere they choose.
sentences.zh: 能够吸引并留住员工的典型举措包括传统的弹性工时制，以及得益于技术进步而成为可能的远程办公——员工可在家、海外或几乎任何他们选择的地方工作。

sentences.en: Management styles will almost certainly continue to change.
sentences.zh: 管理风格几乎肯定会持续演变。

sentences.en: Senior managers will require a lot more than the efficiency that they've always needed.
sentences.zh: 高级管理者所需的能力将远不止以往一贯强调的效率。

sentences.en: Above all they'll need great skills.
sentences.zh: 最重要的是，他们需要卓越的领导力技能，

sentences.en: in leadership, so that their organisation can initiate and respond to change in a fast-moving world, where they face lots of competing requirements and potential conflicts.
sentences.zh: 以便其组织能在瞬息万变的世界中主动发起变革并迅速应对变革，而在此类环境中，他们需面对诸多相互竞争的要求及潜在冲突。

sentences.en: In most of the world, the senior managers of large businesses are mainly men in their fifties and sixties.
sentences.zh: 在全球大多数地区，大型企业的高级管理者主要为五六十岁的男性。

sentences.en: The predominant style of management will almost certainly become.
sentences.zh: 主流管理风格几乎肯定会转变为

sentences.en: more consultative and collaborative, caused above all, by more women moving to senior management positions.
sentences.zh: 更具协商性和协作性，而这主要源于更多女性晋升至高级管理岗位。

sentences.en: Many of the changes are influenced by developments in the wider economy.
sentences.zh: 许多变化都受到更广泛经济环境发展的影响。

sentences.en: The traditional emphasis of business was manufacturing, and of course the service sector is very important.
sentences.zh: 传统上，企业的重心在于制造业，当然服务业也极为重要。

sentences.en: But we shouldn't overlook the growing financial contribution of IP, that is, intellectual property.
sentences.zh: 但我们不应忽视知识产权（IP）日益增长的财务贡献。

sentences.en: Some books and films generate enormous sums from the sale of related DVDs, music, games, clothes, and so on.
sentences.zh: 一些图书和电影通过相关DVD、音乐、游戏、服装等衍生品的销售，获得了巨额收益。

sentences.en: Another point I'd like to make is that although I've been talking about companies, one trend that they have to face is the move away from people working for the same employer for years.
sentences.zh: 我还想指出的一点是：尽管我一直在谈论企业，但它们必须面对的一个趋势是，人们长期受雇于同一家雇主的现象正在减弱。

sentences.en: Instead, more and more people are becoming self-employed, to gain the freedom and control over their lives that they're unlikely to get from being employed.
sentences.zh: 相反，越来越多的人选择自主创业，以获得他们在受雇状态下难以企及的生活自由与掌控权。

sentences.en: OK, well that's all I want to say, SO let's open it up for discussion.
sentences.zh: 好的，以上就是我想讲的全部内容，现在让我们开放讨论。

sentences.en: Audioscripts
sentences.zh: 听力原文
